parameter_source: Installed DWSIM 9.0.5 AdvancedEOS compound and interaction library; exact native values captured with every diagnostic batch.
missing_binary_policy: Explicit native-zero-kij hypothesis for diagnostic screening only; missing entries are reported and never counted as fitted binary parameters.
limitations: Associating PC-SAFT is a separate model, not an HOC implementation or exact literature reproduction.
Native association topology and missing binary coefficients require empirical checks before design admission.
A VLE test alone cannot qualify all ternary phases, caloric properties or complete-process design.
